h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raichur

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raichur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Raichur

c: Raichur summers are long and harsh, and that shapes how we plan an outdoor gym here. FunPlay Systems supplies open gym equipment to municipal parks, schools, colleges and the residential townships around the thermal power station in Raichur. Every machine in our Fun Fitness range is built at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 590 km away, and travels to you by road.

Most Raichur buyers want machines that people of any age can use without a trainer. Our equipment works on body weight and simple movement, so a retired person and a college student can share the same station. We install it with our own team or a dealer close to you, using a grouted base or a self-standing frame, whichever suits the soil. Send us a sketch of the area and we will propose a layout.

richText.heading: Heat, dust and shade on a Raichur site

c: The Deccan sun between March and May heats bare metal quickly, so we suggest placing the gym where trees or a shed give morning and evening shade. That is when most people exercise anyway. Galvanised pipe frames resist rust through the monsoon, and roto-moulded seats and handles stay cooler to touch than painted steel.

items.q: Can you supply an outdoor gym to a power plant township in Raichur?
items.a: Yes. Townships usually have a central park or walking path, which suits an open gym well. Share the space dimensions and photos, and we will suggest machines and send a layout drawing.

items.q: Does the equipment get too hot to use in summer?
items.a: Metal in direct sun gets hot anywhere. Placing the gym under tree cover or a shed, and using it in the morning and evening, makes a large difference. The roto-moulded parts heat up less than bare steel.

items.q: What warranty do you offer on the machines?
items.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. This covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as we advise.
